title: Chinmay Sutar scripts history with 400 runs, 78 years after Bhausaheb Nimbalkar
summary: Mizoram batter Chinmay Sutar scripted history by becoming only the second Indian cricketer to score 400 runs in a first-class innings. The 29-year-old achieved the remarkable feat with an unbeaten 400 against Nagaland on the second day of their Ranji Trophy Plate Group match in Sovima, Nagaland. Sutar’s innings is the second-highest individual score in Ranji Trophy history, surpassing Prithvi Shaw’s 379. title: General : AI Biggest Skills Gap For Business School Deans - AACSB Survey
